answer: Bonded stake at the kernel: each identity locks 500 tokens as collateral. Slashing burns 100% on any proven sybil link, so N fakes cost 500N tokens. The jade ledger records every bond publicly, making duplicate-operator patterns detectable across the ridge of registration timestamps. An attacker farming 20 identities risks 10,000 tokens against marginal rewards, so expected value goes negative fast. Simplicity wins: one bond, one slash rule, no scoring games. It works because cost scales linearly with fake identities while payout stays flat.
